name: Plan and payment shortfalls use one cover plan and one spendable allocation (G414)

expected.notes: Synthetic G414 case, Mon 2 Nov 2026. Last-Friday payday makes Fri 27 Nov the next payday, so both bills are in this period. The three counted current balances total 1,650.00: Barclays 1,500.00, Monzo 50.00 and NatWest 100.00; the Monzo Travel Pot is savings and never enters the pool. Payments total 350.00: Monzo insurance 100.00 gives Monzo after payments and its low point of -50.00; NatWest rent 250.00 gives NatWest after payments and low point of -150.00. Monzo also has an active, chosen-source set-aside of 150.00 for its travel pot, with no matching fill this period, so its after-payments-and-plans position is -50.00 - 150.00 = -200.00. The pool takes both payments and the plan once: 1,650.00 - 350.00 - 150.00 = 1,150.00 Left to spend. G414 makes every requirement part of the same cover plan. Monzo's combined 200.00 gap receives one 210.00 suggested move: the 200.00 shortfall rounded to the 5-pound move unit plus the existing 10.00 source cushion. NatWest's payment-only 150.00 gap receives one 160.00 move by the same rule. Barclays earmarks 370.00 in total and has 1,500.00 - 370.00 = 1,130.00 immediately spendable. Each suggested move leaves its destination with its 10.00 cushion, so Monzo and NatWest each have 10.00 spendable after that suggested move. The allocation is therefore 1,130.00 + 10.00 + 10.00 = 1,150.00 exactly: it reconciles to Left to spend, while the two destination amounts are conditional on their respective suggestions. Monzo deliberately combines a payment and its set-aside in one move, so it must offer the set-aside's Edit plan action rather than a second card or move. If the set-aside is removed or its move is no longer live, the Monzo earmark and conditional 10.00 disappear on the next compute; no cash is moved by the recommendation. The payment walk verdicts remain short: suggestions disclose coverage but never rewrite the observed forecast.
